Plans FAQs

What is CMLink Singapore SIM?

CMLink Singapore SIM is a postpaid mobile service by China Mobile International in Singapore. We provide unique products and services to bring convenience and savings to customers who frequent mainland China and Hong Kong SAR. In addition, we utilise Singtel's mobile network so you can be assured of the same quality network coverage!

What are the features of CMLink Singapore SIM?

Our features include, but are not limited to: 
- APAC roaming data for use in Australia, China (including Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan), Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, South Korea, Thailand and Vietnam.
- Bundled international call minutes to mainland China and Hong Kong SAR, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and USA.
- Multi-country or regional roaming data and voice add-ons.
- 1-Card-Multi-Number (1CMN) service: Receive SMSes and voice calls forwarded from your China Mobile mainland China or Hong Kong SAR number on your CMLink number. Your China Mobile SIM card no longer needs to be switched on. You can even apply for a new China Mobile mainland China and Hong Kong SAR number if you do not have one. 
- 24/7 English and Chinese language customer service.

What type of CMLink plans are there?

We offer 4G and 5G+ plans with different data, voice and SMS entitlements to suit different customer needs. You can sign up for a no contract SIM-only plan or a contract plan that comes with more plan entitlements. Some of our price plans also allow you to enjoy 5G+ services and include Asia/APAC roaming data. Click here for more details! 
We also offer Corporate Individual Scheme plans. Visit CIS to find out more.  
All plans include:  
1. Local minutes and local SMS.  
2. Roaming data that can be shared in mainland China and Hong Kong SAR. 
3. International call minutes that can be used in Singapore to call mainland China, Hong Kong SAR, USA, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand. 
4. Free Caller ID and SIM delivery.

How do I sign up?

You can sign up online.  
Alternatively, you can sign up via our WeChat Official Account ‘CMLink_SG‘ or visit any of our Channel Partners.
